name: Milnor.Problems.normalBundleSet
why: Both are {(x, v) | x in M, v orthogonal to T_xM}; the project's T_xM is the range of the derivative of the inclusion (= Morse.tangentSubspace), the blind one the span of velocities of smooth curves in M. These tangent spaces are equal for every slice submanifold (the Morse_tangentSubspace argument, re-proved in the file), so the sets are equal for every hM.
